thread:
maria: Heads-up — CloudHarbor asked if we can onboard eu-west-3 (Lisbon) marketplace SKU next sprint. They want dedicated capacity + marketplace listing at launch.

tomas: Nice. Do we have available capacity in that region? what hardware?

maria: CloudHarbor proposal: 40x A100s initially, option to scale to 100 within 8 weeks. Hardware partner is ApexHW, will ship blades into our colo partner.

olga: Ops: we currently have a soft quota in eu-west-3 of 30 GPUs pending partner approval. We can reallocate 10 from staging, but 40+ would need quota bump and approval from capacity-control.

kevin: Sales: the partner marketing team wants a joint announcement the week after go-live. Need entitlements and billing mapping before that.

julie: Legal: we'll need the partner addendum for marketplace listing + data flow annex for eu customers. Can we get a proposed SOW / traffic matrix?

maria: Attached ask from CloudHarbor: they sent a spreadsheet (link) with expected qps and top architectures. Also included SI contact: NovaSI for integration. They want canary on dedicated pool, then fallback to hosted.

olga: Ops note: KMS + HSM requirement in eu-west-3 — partner wants customer-managed keys (BYOK). We need KMS integration plan and HSM certs.

tomas: For a quick path: we can provision a temporary Dedicated pool using existing eu-west-2 kernel images, but we must validate quantization/benchmarks. I can run perf jobs if ops can front the quota.

maria: Proposal timeline: Week 0: legal/SOW sign + quota request; Week 1: infra provisioning + KMS setup; Week 2: SI integration + canary; Week 3: rollback and full launch. Marketing week 4 for announcement. Thoughts?

kevin: That timeline is tight but doable if legal approves copy by EOD Wed. I’ll push partner to accept conditional announcement (soft-date) until final perf sign-off.

julie: I'll review SOW by tomorrow morning. Need to flag: data residency clause + audit log retention 7 years if they request enterprise SLA. Also check DPAs with ApexHW for hardware telemetry.

olga: Capacity-control: @tomas can you add required capacity request details here? quota request should include SKU IDs and expected peak tokens/s.

tomas: Sure — draft quota request: SKU: AW-REDWOOD-DEDI-A100, region: eu-west-3, initial units: 40, burst to 100, expected peak 1.2M tokens/min. I'll paste template: ```sku: AW-REDWOOD-DEDI-A100
region: eu-west-3
initial: 40
burst: 100
start_date: 1768124000```

maria: Also need marketplace entitlements: partner-managed billing vs our billing. CloudHarbor prefers partner billing with our metered usage callback. Any objections?

kevin: Partner billing is fine but ensure we have invoice mapping + usage export so CloudHarbor can reconcile. Finance will need 48h to map SKU codes.

julie: Compliance check: if partner-managed billing means we pass PII in webhooks, ensure webhook endpoint is IP-restricted and signed. Add clause to SOW.

olga: Ops checklist to unblock: 1) capacity approval 2) KMS certs from ApexHW 3) marketplace SKU created 4) SI access to staging cluster. I can take 1 & 3 if legal greenlights.

maria: Action items assigned: @julie review SOW by Tue, @tomas submit quota request to capacity-control immediately, @olga raise KMS cert request to ApexHW, @kevin coordinate announcement window with partner.

deploy-bot: Deployment ticket created: RED-PRT-4532 (eu-west-3 marketplace onboarding) — https://redwood.atlassian/RED-PRT-4532

kevin: Quick Q on announcement: do we want joint blog + partner webinar? If yes, need slides and 1 customer quote.

maria: Let's aim for joint blog + 30-min webinar. I'll ask CloudHarbor for a customer case.

tomas: One more technical risk: ApexHW firmware version older than our validated baseline can cause perf regressions with our kernel. I'll request firmware manifest and ask ApexHW to certify.

julie: Flagging contractual requirement: hardware vendor must sign firmware attestation for production release. I will draft an addendum clause.

olga: Ops can queue a canary smoke test template: 
- deploy image to 2 nodes
- run perf harness 10k tokens/min for 30m
- validate P95 latency < 300ms
- validate KV cache hit >= 80%

maria: Great. If everyone agrees, I'll consolidate and send a partner email tonight with next steps and the Atlassian ticket. Can folks reply with final yes/no in thread? :thumbsup:

kevin: +1

julie: +1 (will post SOW comments inline)

tomas: +1, submitting quota now

olga: +1, raising KMS cert request

maria: Thanks — will send email at 18:00 UTC and update RED-PRT-4532.
